notes.title: Formula Retro Racing: World Tour demo freeze bug update
notes.content:
Hey, a quick update on Formula Retro Racing: World Tour’s current demo...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/f886849223ae8bd8681fd7706a892dc2b576cdae.jpg[/img]

Firstly, thanks to everyone for the feedback so far! It’s been really useful to the development process and helps us identify errors prior to release.

We wanted to let you know that we're aware of the drift car freeze bug in the demo and are working hard on getting a fix out as soon as possible. 

We're pleased to announce that the team have managed to recreate the problem and our developers are looking into a solution.

We anticipate getting the new build with the freeze bug removed and other small fixes[b] tomorrow.[/b]

This issue seems to be exclusive to the stock cars, and not affecting the F1 cars[b]. (We recommend players stick to F1 cars until the problem is resolved!)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/3f183131885bd44a21ea68041cb73e73191c3fba.gif[/img]

Thanks for your patience and for playing,

CGA Studio Games/Repixel8 

P.S. If you haven't joined our new discord server, here's the link: https://discord.gg/Js6ECpvTMU

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/4f9f6b808521662149d246b60f7de14092cfd951.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update - Formula Retro Racing: World Tour VR is here!
notes.content:
[i][h3]Put yourself in the hot seat with an intense virtual reality mode! This full driving experience is so realistic you're sure to be leaning into the corners as you race through the chicanes and hairpins in a Formula race car on your pick of World Tour’s racing circuits[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/f886849223ae8bd8681fd7706a892dc2b576cdae.jpg[/img]

Get up close and personal to the high-speed action with our latest demo update and feel the thrill of competing like never before.  From the cockpit, you’ll be able to immerse yourself in the epic thrills of tracks like London, Paris, and New York and zoom past recognisable landmarks from across the world.

Whether you want the adrenaline rush of VR driving for your own Free Practice, Arcade Mode, or challenge yourself in Grand Prix and Eliminator mode, you’ll be able to experience it in VR.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[b]NEW[/b] Virtual Reality Mode
[b]NEW[/b] Car Types 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/3f183131885bd44a21ea68041cb73e73191c3fba.gif[/img]

[h2]Vehicle types[/h2]
Race in a number of exciting new vehicle types, including high-performance race cars and muscle cars that can drift through corners. Each of the two car classes has five variations: five different single-seater style formula cars (including touring, rally and cigar) and five muscle cars with throwback vehicles spanning from the 40s to the noughties. Each car handles uniquely, making each track feel different. It’s up to you to find the best lines and breaking points for each vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/4a0e15f0f8a1562cadfaa651adaedc69e1144788.gif[/img]

[h2]Feedback
[/h2]
CGA Studio Games and Repixel8 are still analysing areas to improve, and this includes ensuring all bug fixes and improvements are implemented prior to release. This demo patch supporting Open VR is still experimental and we expect some problems to emerge, whether from headset incompatibility or general buggy-ness… this is where you can help us! 

Unfortunately, we don’t have every headset on hand to test ourselves, so please drop us a line if you encounter any speed bumps - we really appreciate it!

[url=https://discord.gg/Js6ECpvTMU]Join our new discord![/url]

We would like to thank you for your continued support on this journey. Excitement for the game and demo feedback on Steam inspires us every day and we cannot wait to share more about the future of Formula Retro Racing: World Tour with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42953499/4f9f6b808521662149d246b60f7de14092cfd951.png[/img]
